Included by Columbus_Spatial_Analysis.Rmd after analysis/core.Rmd, with include = FALSE.
Writes output/simulasi/ and output/rds/simulasi_crime.rds, and injects the results into dashboard_html/index.html.

```{r sim-setup}
# Bab revisi: simulasi robustness matriks bobot untuk satu variabel (CRIME).
# Bisa dijalankan sebagai bab dalam Rmd utama (objek LW, col sudah ada) atau berdiri sendiri.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(sf); library(spdep); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(knitr) })
if (!exists("LW"))  LW  <- readRDS("output/rds/weights_listw.rds")
if (!exists("col") || !inherits(col, "sf")) col <- st_read("data/geoda_sal/columbus.shp", quiet = TRUE)
if (!exists("kt"))  kt  <- function(df, digits = 4, ...) kable(df, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ""), ...)
f2 <- function(v, d = 3) formatC(v, format = "f", digits = d, decimal.mark = ",")
SIM_OUT <- file.path("output", "simulasi"); dir.create(SIM_OUT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sim_csv <- function(df, name) write.csv(df, file.path(SIM_OUT, paste0(name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
sim_png <- function(p, name, w = 9, h = 6) ggsave(file.path(SIM_OUT, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150, bg = "white")

SIM_SEED <- 20261117L; A <- 0.05
x0  <- col$CRIME; n <- length(x0)
ids <- names(LW); Wd <- lapply(LW, listw2mat)
lab <- setNames(sub("_B$", " · B", sub("_W$", " · W", ids)), ids)
lab <- setNames(c("Queen · B","Queen · W","Rook · B","Rook · W",
                  paste0("k = ", rep(c(2,3,4,5,6,8), each = 2), c(" · B"," · W")),
                  paste0("d ≤ ", rep(c("0,62","0,75","0,90","1,10","1,35","1,65"), each = 2), c(" · B"," · W")),
                  "1/d · mentah","1/d · W","1/d² · mentah","1/d² · W"), ids)
fam <- setNames(rep(c("Contiguity","KNN","Distance band","Inverse distance"), c(4,12,12,4)), ids)

# I dan C tervektorisasi untuk banyak kumpulan data sekaligus (kolom X = satu kumpulan data)
stat_IC <- function(W, X) {
  Z <- sweep(X, 2, colMeans(X)); m2 <- colSums(Z^2); S0 <- sum(W)
  q <- colSums(Z * (W %*% Z)); rc <- rowSums(W) + colSums(W)
  list(I = n / S0 * q / m2, C = (n - 1) / (2 * S0) * (colSums(rc * Z^2) - 2 * q) / m2)
}
# Momen randomisasi. Semua data simulasi adalah susunan ulang nilai CRIME, sehingga kurtosis
# (dan karenanya E dan Var di bawah H0 randomisasi) sama untuk setiap ulangan: cukup dihitung sekali per W.
mom <- t(sapply(ids, function(id) {
  m <- moran.test(x0, LW[[id]], randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate
  g <- geary.test(x0, LW[[id]], randomisation = TRUE, zero.policy = TRUE)$estimate
  c(EI = m[[2]], sdI = sqrt(m[[3]]), EC = g[[2]], sdC = sqrt(g[[3]]))
}))
```

```{r sim-tests}
set.seed(SIM_SEED)
Q  <- Wd[["queen_B"]]; QW <- Wd[["queen_W"]]
one <- function(W, x) { s <- stat_IC(W, matrix(x)); c(I = s$I, C = s$C) }
obs <- t(sapply(ids, function(id) one(Wd[[id]], x0)))

# U1. Implementasi = spdep
u1 <- max(sapply(ids, function(id) max(abs(obs[id, "I"] - moran(x0, LW[[id]], n, Szero(LW[[id]]), zero.policy = TRUE)$I),
                                       abs(obs[id, "C"] - geary(x0, LW[[id]], n, n - 1, Szero(LW[[id]]), zero.policy = TRUE)$C))))
# U2. Label: ubah urutan wilayah pada x dan W secara bersamaan (P x, P W P')
u2 <- max(sapply(1:200, function(r) { p <- sample(n); max(sapply(ids, function(id) max(abs(one(Wd[[id]][p, p], x0[p]) - obs[id, ])))) }))
# U3. Letak: susunan ulang tetangga. Jumlah tetangga tiap wilayah dipertahankan, tetapi siapa tetangganya diacak.
rewire <- function(W) { R <- matrix(0, n, n); for (i in 1:n) { k <- sum(W[i, ] > 0); R[i, sample(setdiff(1:n, i), k)] <- 1 }; R }
rw <- t(replicate(999, one(rewire(Q), x0)))
# U4. Diagonal: w_ii = 1 pada Queen biner
QD <- Q + diag(n); od <- one(QD, x0); z <- x0 - mean(x0)
u4_I_pred <- n / sum(QD) * (sum(z * (Q %*% z)) + sum(z^2)) / sum(z^2)     # I dengan diagonal (rumus)
u4_C_pred <- obs["queen_B", "C"] * sum(Q) / sum(QD)                         # C hanya berubah lewat S0
# U5. Simetrisasi (W + W')/2 dan U6. skala c·W
u5 <- max(sapply(ids, function(id) max(abs(one((Wd[[id]] + t(Wd[[id]])) / 2, x0) - obs[id, ]))))
u6 <- max(sapply(ids, function(id) max(abs(one(7.3 * Wd[[id]], x0) - obs[id, ]))))
# U7. Momen randomisasi analitik vs momen 9.999 permutasi
P <- replicate(9999, sample(x0))
emp <- t(sapply(ids, function(id) { s <- stat_IC(Wd[[id]], P); c(mean(s$I), sd(s$I), mean(s$C), sd(s$C)) }))
u7 <- max(abs(emp[, c(2, 4)] / mom[, c("sdI", "sdC")] - 1))

comp <- data.frame(
  Uji = c("U1 Implementasi tervektorisasi = spdep (32 W)",
          "U2 Label: ubah urutan wilayah pada x dan W bersamaan (200 kali × 32 W)",
          "U3 Letak: tetangga Queen diacak, jumlah tetangga tetap (999 kali)",
          "U4a Diagonal w_ii = 1 pada Queen: Moran's I",
          "U4b Diagonal w_ii = 1 pada Queen: Geary's C",
          "U5 Simetrisasi (W + W')/2 (32 W)",
          "U6 Skala 7,3 · W (32 W)",
          "U7 SD analitik vs SD 9.999 permutasi (32 W, I dan C)"),
  Hasil = c(sprintf("maks |selisih| = %.1e", u1),
            sprintf("maks |selisih| = %.1e", u2),
            sprintf("I: %s → rata-rata %s (SD %s); C: %s → %s",
                    f2(obs["queen_B","I"]), f2(mean(rw[,1])), f2(sd(rw[,1])), f2(obs["queen_B","C"]), f2(mean(rw[,2]))),
            sprintf("%s → %s (rumus: %s)", f2(obs["queen_B","I"]), f2(od["I"]), f2(u4_I_pred)),
            sprintf("%s → %s (= C × S0/S0' = %s)", f2(obs["queen_B","C"]), f2(od["C"]), f2(u4_C_pred)),
            sprintf("maks |selisih| = %.1e", u5),
            sprintf("maks |selisih| = %.1e", u6),
            sprintf("maks |rasio − 1| = %s", f2(u7, 3))),
  Kesimpulan = c("Lulus", "Tidak bergantung pada label",
                 "Bergantung pada letak", "Bergantung pada diagonal",
                 "Pembilang tidak bergantung pada diagonal", "Hanya bagian simetris yang dipakai",
                 "Tidak bergantung pada skala", "Momen analitik sah dipakai"))
kt(comp)
sim_csv(comp, "S01_uji_komputasi")
```

```{r sim-run}
GEN  <- c("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4", "G5")
glab <- c(G1 = "G1 SAR Queen", G2 = "G2 SAR k = 4", G3 = "G3 SAR pita 1,10", G4 = "G4 Geostatistik", G5 = "G5 Tren radial")
gW   <- c(G1 = "queen_W", G2 = "knn4_W", G3 = "band110_W")
LVL  <- c(0.30, 0.50, 0.70, 0.90); R0 <- 5000L; R1 <- 1000L
xs   <- sort(x0); dis <- as.numeric(scale(col$DISCBD))
Dm   <- as.matrix(dist(st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_geometry(col)))))
Lg   <- t(chol(exp(-Dm / 1)))
to_crime <- function(Y) apply(Y, 2, function(y) xs[rank(y, ties.method = "first")])
gen_X <- function(g, s, R) {
  E <- matrix(rnorm(n * R), n, R)
  Y <- switch(g, G4 = sqrt(s) * Lg %*% matrix(rnorm(n * R), n, R) + sqrt(1 - s) * E,
                 G5 = -s * dis + sqrt(1 - s^2) * E,
                 solve(diag(n) - s * Wd[[gW[g]]], E))
  to_crime(Y)
}
test_all <- function(X) {               # keputusan untuk 32 W: +1 positif, -1 negatif, 0 tidak signifikan
  zc <- qnorm(1 - A / 2)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(ids, function(id) {
    s <- stat_IC(Wd[[id]], X)
    zI <- (s$I - mom[id, "EI"]) / mom[id, "sdI"]; zC <- (mom[id, "EC"] - s$C) / mom[id, "sdC"]
    data.frame(W = id, dI = sign(zI) * (abs(zI) > zc), dC = sign(zC) * (abs(zC) > zc), I = s$I, C = s$C)
  }))
}
summ <- function(d, g, lv, par) d |> group_by(W) |>
  summarise(rej_I = mean(dI != 0), pow_I = mean(dI == 1), rej_C = mean(dC != 0), pow_C = mean(dC == 1),
            agree = mean(dI == dC), mean_I = mean(I), mean_C = mean(C), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(gen = g, level = lv, param = par)

# Kalibrasi: untuk tiap pembangkit, cari parameter kekuatan yang membuat daya Moran terbaik = 0,30/0,50/0,70/0,90
set.seed(SIM_SEED)
GRID <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)
cal_grid <- bind_rows(lapply(GEN, function(g) bind_rows(lapply(GRID, function(s)
  data.frame(gen = g, param = s, oracle = max(summ(test_all(gen_X(g, s, 500)), g, NA, s)$pow_I))))))
cal <- bind_rows(lapply(GEN, function(g) { d <- filter(cal_grid, gen == g)
  data.frame(gen = g, level = LVL, param = approx(cummax(d$oracle), d$param, xout = LVL, ties = "ordered")$y) }))

set.seed(SIM_SEED + 2)
null_X <- replicate(R0, sample(x0)); res <- list(summ(test_all(null_X), "H0", 0, 0))
check_marg <- all(apply(null_X, 2, function(v) identical(sort(v), xs)))
for (k in seq_len(nrow(cal))) {
  X <- gen_X(cal$gen[k], cal$param[k], R1)
  check_marg <- check_marg && all(apply(X, 2, function(v) identical(sort(v), xs)))
  res[[length(res) + 1]] <- summ(test_all(X), cal$gen[k], cal$level[k], cal$param[k])
}
sim <- bind_rows(res) |> mutate(label = lab[W], family = fam[W])
cal_out <- sim |> filter(gen != "H0") |> group_by(gen, level, param) |>
  summarise(`Daya terbaik tercapai` = max(pow_I), `Matriks terbaik` = lab[W[which.max(pow_I)]], .groups = "drop") |>
  transmute(Pembangkit = glab[gen], `Target daya terbaik` = level, `Parameter kekuatan` = param,
            `Daya terbaik tercapai`, `Matriks terbaik`)
kt(cal_out, 3)
sim_csv(cal_out, "S02a_kalibrasi_kekuatan"); sim_csv(cal_grid, "S02b_grid_kalibrasi"); sim_csv(sim, "S02_hasil_simulasi_lengkap")
```

```{r sim-verify}
# V1. Uji analitik vs uji permutasi 999 kali pada 300 ulangan nol untuk 4 matriks
set.seed(SIM_SEED + 1)
perm_p <- function(W, x, R = 999) { s0 <- stat_IC(W, matrix(x)); s <- stat_IC(W, replicate(R, sample(x)))
  c(pI = min(1, 2 * min(mean(c(s$I, s0$I) >= s0$I), mean(c(s$I, s0$I) <= s0$I))),
    pC = min(1, 2 * min(mean(c(s$C, s0$C) >= s0$C), mean(c(s$C, s0$C) <= s0$C)))) }
chkW <- c("queen_W", "knn4_W", "band110_B", "idw2_B")
v1 <- bind_rows(lapply(chkW, function(id) {
  pp <- t(sapply(1:300, function(r) perm_p(Wd[[id]], null_X[, r])))
  aa <- test_all(null_X[, 1:300]) |> filter(W == id)
  data.frame(W = lab[id], `Size permutasi I` = mean(pp[, "pI"] <= A), `Size analitik I` = mean(aa$dI != 0),
             `Keputusan I sama (%)` = 100 * mean((pp[, "pI"] <= A) == (aa$dI != 0)),
             `Size permutasi C` = mean(pp[, "pC"] <= A), `Size analitik C` = mean(aa$dC != 0),
             `Keputusan C sama (%)` = 100 * mean((pp[, "pC"] <= A) == (aa$dC != 0)), check.names = FALSE)
}))
# V2. Moran rata-rata naik monoton terhadap kekuatan pola pada matriks pembangkitnya sendiri
v2 <- sim |> filter(gen != "H0") |> group_by(gen, level) |> summarise(m = mean(mean_I), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(gen, level) |> group_by(gen) |> summarise(`Monoton naik` = all(diff(m) > 0),
  `Rata-rata I (tingkat 0,30)` = first(m), `Rata-rata I (tingkat 0,90)` = last(m)) |> mutate(gen = glab[gen])
# V3. Reprodusibilitas: skenario G1, rho = 0,30 diulang dengan seed yang sama
rep_once <- function() { set.seed(99); E <- matrix(rnorm(n * 200), n, 200)
  test_all(to_crime(solve(diag(n) - 0.3 * Wd[["queen_W"]], E))) }
v3 <- identical(rep_once(), rep_once())
mcse <- sqrt(A * (1 - A) / R0)
verify <- data.frame(
  Pemeriksaan = c("Sebaran nilai data simulasi = sebaran CRIME asli (25.000 kumpulan data)",
                  "Rata-rata Moran's I (32 W) naik monoton terhadap tingkat kekuatan pada kelima pembangkit",
                  "Hasil identik bila dijalankan ulang dengan seed yang sama",
                  "Galat Monte Carlo size pada 5.000 ulangan nol (SE)",
                  "Kesesuaian keputusan uji analitik vs permutasi 999 kali (median, 4 W × 300 ulangan)"),
  Hasil = c(check_marg, all(v2$`Monoton naik`), v3, f2(mcse, 4),
            paste0(f2(median(c(v1[[4]], v1[[7]])), 1), "%")))
kt(verify); kt(v1, 3); kt(v2, 3)
sim_csv(verify, "S03_uji_komputasi_simulasi"); sim_csv(v1, "S04_analitik_vs_permutasi")
```

```{r sim-size}
size <- sim |> filter(gen == "H0") |> transmute(W, Spesifikasi = label, Keluarga = family,
  `Size Moran` = rej_I, `Size Geary` = rej_C,
  `K1 Moran` = ifelse(between(rej_I, .025, .075), "Wajar", "Tidak wajar"),
  `K1 Geary` = ifelse(between(rej_C, .025, .075), "Wajar", "Tidak wajar"))
kt(size[, -1], 3)
p_size <- size |> pivot_longer(c(`Size Moran`, `Size Geary`), names_to = "Indeks", values_to = "s") |>
  mutate(Indeks = sub("Size ", "", Indeks), Spesifikasi = factor(Spesifikasi, rev(lab))) |>
  ggplot(aes(s, Spesifikasi, colour = Indeks)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = .025, xmax = .075, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#e8f5e9") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .05, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") + geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Moran = "#1f3a5f", Geary = "#b9461b")) +
  labs(title = "K1: ukuran uji pada skenario tanpa pola (5.000 ulangan)",
       subtitle = "Pita hijau = rentang wajar Bradley (0,025–0,075)", x = "Proporsi H₀ ditolak", y = NULL)
p_size; sim_png(p_size, "S05_ukuran_uji", 8, 8)
```

```{r sim-power, fig.height = 9}
alt <- sim |> filter(gen != "H0")
best <- alt |> group_by(gen, level) |> summarise(bI = max(pow_I), bC = max(pow_C), .groups = "drop")
reg <- alt |> left_join(best, by = c("gen", "level")) |> mutate(regI = bI - pow_I, regC = bC - pow_C)
crit <- reg |> group_by(W) |> summarise(
  `K2 daya rata-rata Moran` = mean(pow_I), `K3 penyesalan maks Moran` = max(regI),
  `K4 daya terburuk (tingkat 0,50) Moran` = min(pow_I[level == 0.50]),
  `K2 daya rata-rata Geary` = mean(pow_C), `K3 penyesalan maks Geary` = max(regC),
  `K4 daya terburuk (tingkat 0,50) Geary` = min(pow_C[level == 0.50]),
  `K5 kesepakatan` = mean(agree), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(size |> select(W, `Size Moran`, `Size Geary`, `K1 Moran`, `K1 Geary`), by = "W") |>
  mutate(Kelas = case_when(`K1 Moran` == "Tidak wajar" | `K3 penyesalan maks Moran` > .30 ~ "Sensitif",
                           `K3 penyesalan maks Moran` <= .15 ~ "Robust", TRUE ~ "Menengah"),
         `Kelas (Geary)` = case_when(`K1 Geary` == "Tidak wajar" | `K3 penyesalan maks Geary` > .30 ~ "Sensitif",
                                     `K3 penyesalan maks Geary` <= .15 ~ "Robust", TRUE ~ "Menengah"),
         `Penyesalan maks gabungan` = pmax(`K3 penyesalan maks Moran`, `K3 penyesalan maks Geary`),
         Spesifikasi = lab[W], Keluarga = fam[W]) |>
  arrange(`K3 penyesalan maks Moran`, desc(`K2 daya rata-rata Moran`))
crit_show <- crit |> transmute(Peringkat = row_number(), Spesifikasi, Keluarga, `Size Moran`,
  `K2 daya rata-rata Moran`, `K3 penyesalan maks Moran`, `K4 daya terburuk (tingkat 0,50) Moran`,
  `K3 penyesalan maks Geary`, `Penyesalan maks gabungan`, `K5 kesepakatan`, `Kelas (Moran)` = Kelas, `Kelas (Geary)`)
kt(crit_show, 3)
sim_csv(crit, "S06_kriteria_per_matriks")

pw <- alt |> filter(level == 0.50) |> mutate(Spesifikasi = factor(label, rev(crit$Spesifikasi)), Pembangkit = glab[gen])
p_heat <- ggplot(pw, aes(Pembangkit, Spesifikasi, fill = pow_I)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = f2(pow_I, 2)), size = 3, colour = ifelse(pw$pow_I > .6, "white", "black")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f4f1ea", high = "#1f3a5f", limits = c(0, 1), name = "Daya") +
  labs(title = "Daya Moran's I pada tingkat kekuatan sedang (daya matriks terbaik = 0,50)",
       subtitle = "Baris diurutkan dari penyesalan maksimum terkecil (paling robust) di atas", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
p_heat; sim_png(p_heat, "S07_daya_tingkat050", 9, 10)
```

```{r sim-curve, fig.height = 6}
cur <- alt |> filter(W %in% pick) |> mutate(Spesifikasi = factor(label, lab[pick]), Pembangkit = glab[gen])
```

```{r sim-robust-check}
# Kepekaan klasifikasi terhadap batas: apakah matriks rekomendasi tetap sama bila batas diubah?
rec_id <- crit |> filter(`K1 Moran` == "Wajar") |> slice_min(`K3 penyesalan maks Moran`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(W)
rec_C  <- crit |> filter(`K1 Geary` == "Wajar") |> slice_min(`K3 penyesalan maks Geary`, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(W)
alt_rule <- reg |> group_by(W) |> summarise(mean_reg = mean(regI), q90 = quantile(regI, .9), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(size |> select(W, `K1 Moran`), by = "W") |> filter(`K1 Moran` == "Wajar")
top3 <- function(v) paste(lab[alt_rule$W[order(v)][1:3]], collapse = "; ")
sens_rule <- data.frame(
  `Aturan pemilihan` = c("Penyesalan maksimum (utama)", "Penyesalan rata-rata", "Persentil ke-90 penyesalan",
                         "Hanya pola lemah–sedang (tingkat ≤ 0,50)"),
  `Tiga teratas` = c(paste(head(crit |> filter(`K1 Moran` == "Wajar") |> pull(Spesifikasi), 3), collapse = "; "),
                     top3(alt_rule$mean_reg), top3(alt_rule$q90),
                     { w <- reg |> filter(level <= .50) |> group_by(W) |> summarise(m = max(regI)) |>
                         filter(W %in% alt_rule$W) |> arrange(m); paste(lab[w$W[1:3]], collapse = "; ") }),
  check.names = FALSE)
nb_stat <- c(robust = sum(crit$Kelas == "Robust"), menengah = sum(crit$Kelas == "Menengah"), sensitif = sum(crit$Kelas == "Sensitif"))
kt(sens_rule); sim_csv(sens_rule, "S09_kepekaan_aturan")
rcr <- crit |> filter(W == rec_id)
rec_J <- crit |> filter(`K1 Moran` == "Wajar", `K1 Geary` == "Wajar") |> arrange(`Penyesalan maks gabungan`) |> head(3)
se_pow <- sqrt(.25 / R1); se_reg <- sqrt(2) * se_pow   # SE daya terburuk (p = 0,5) dan SE selisih dua daya
both_rob <- crit$Spesifikasi[crit$Kelas == "Robust" & crit$`Kelas (Geary)` == "Robust"]
both_sen <- crit$Spesifikasi[crit$Kelas == "Sensitif" & crit$`Kelas (Geary)` == "Sensitif"]
```

```{r sim-export, include = FALSE}
# Ekspor hasil simulasi untuk dashboard HTML (sumber tunggal: bab ini). Tidak ada statistik yang dihitung ulang di dashboard.
crit_js <- crit |> transmute(W, label = Spesifikasi, family = Keluarga,
  size_I = `Size Moran`, size_C = `Size Geary`, pow_I = `K2 daya rata-rata Moran`, pow_C = `K2 daya rata-rata Geary`,
  reg_I = `K3 penyesalan maks Moran`, reg_C = `K3 penyesalan maks Geary`, reg_J = `Penyesalan maks gabungan`,
  worst_I = `K4 daya terburuk (tingkat 0,50) Moran`, worst_C = `K4 daya terburuk (tingkat 0,50) Geary`,
  agree = `K5 kesepakatan`, k1_I = `K1 Moran`, k1_C = `K1 Geary`, cls_I = Kelas, cls_C = `Kelas (Geary)`)
sim_res <- list(
  meta = list(variable = "CRIME", rec_id = rec_id, rec_label = unname(lab[rec_id]), rec_C = rec_C, rec_C_label = unname(lab[rec_C]),
              joint = rec_J$Spesifikasi, joint_reg = rec_J[["Penyesalan maks gabungan"]], R0 = R0, R1 = R1, levels = LVL,
              thr = c(0.15, 0.30), se_pow = se_pow, se_reg = se_reg, seed = SIM_SEED, alpha = A,
              obs_I = unname(obs["queen_B", "I"]), obs_C = unname(obs["queen_B", "C"]),
              rw_I_mean = mean(rw[, 1]), rw_I_sd = sd(rw[, 1]), rw_C_mean = mean(rw[, 2]),
              diag_I = unname(od["I"]), diag_C = unname(od["C"]), EI = -1 / (n - 1)),
  gens = data.frame(id = GEN, label = unname(glab[GEN]),
    form = c("SAR dengan Queen · W", "SAR dengan k = 4 · W", "SAR dengan pita jarak d ≤ 1,10 · W",
             "Geostatistik, kovarians eksponensial e^(−d/1)", "Tren radial dari DISCBD"),
    shape = c("Klaster antartetangga yang bersentuhan", "Klaster antartetangga terdekat", "Klaster dalam radius tetap",
              "Kemiripan meluruh mulus dengan jarak", "Gradien pusat kota ke pinggiran")),
  crit = crit_js,
  power = sim |> filter(gen != "H0") |> select(W, gen, level, param, pow_I, pow_C, agree, mean_I, mean_C),
  rewire_I = rw[, 1], tests = comp, verify = verify, perm_check = v1, calibration = cal_out, rules = sens_rule)
saveRDS(sim_res, file.path("output", "rds", "simulasi_crime.rds"))
sim_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(sim_res, dataframe = "columns", digits = I(10), auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
writeLines(sim_json, file.path(SIM_OUT, "simulasi_crime.json"))
idx <- "dashboard_html/index.html"
if (file.exists(idx)) {
  h <- paste(readLines(idx, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  if (grepl("/*__SIM__*/null", h, fixed = TRUE)) {
    h <- sub("/*__SIM__*/null", gsub("</", "<\\/", sim_json, fixed = TRUE), h, fixed = TRUE)
    writeLines(h, idx, useBytes = TRUE)
  }
}
```
